resources.string: Split
Split Clip — Cuts the selected clip into two separate pieces at the playhead position.
Split the currently selected clip into two clips at the current playhead. The right half becomes a new clip.
Delete
Delete Clip — Removes the selected clip and leaves an empty gap where it was.
Delete the selected clip from the timeline. The space it occupied stays empty; other clips do not move.
Delete and Close
Delete and Close Gap — Removes the selected clip and slides everything after it back so no empty space is left.
Delete the selected clip and move all later clips on the same track earlier by its length, leaving no gap.
Duplicate
Duplicate Clip — Makes an identical copy of the selected clip and places it immediately after the original.
Create a copy of the selected clip with the same settings and place it directly after the original on the same track.
Trim
Trim Clip — Drag either end of a clip to change where it starts or stops without moving it on the timeline.
Trim the selected clip. Drag the left edge to change where it begins, or the right edge to change where it ends.
Speed
Speed Controls — Change how fast or slow the clip plays. Faster makes it shorter; slower makes it longer.
Change the playback speed of the selected clip between 0.1 times and 100 times. The clip length on the timeline changes to match.
Volume
Volume — Make the sound of this clip louder or quieter, or silence it completely.
Adjust the loudness of the selected clip\'s audio. Setting it to zero silences this clip without affecting others.
Transform
Transform — Move, resize, rotate, or flip the picture inside the frame.
Open transform controls to change the position, scale, rotation, opacity, and flip of the selected clip.
Play
Play — Starts playing your video from the playhead position.
Start playback from the current playhead position.
Pause
Pause — Stops playback and leaves the playhead where it is.
Pause playback. The playhead stays at its current position so you can continue from there.
Zoom In
Zoom Timeline In — Makes clips look longer so you can edit more precisely, frame by frame.
Zoom into the timeline. Clips are drawn wider so you can position edits more precisely. Does not change your video.
Zoom Out
Zoom Timeline Out — Makes clips look shorter so you can see more of your project at once.
Zoom out of the timeline so more of the project is visible at once. Does not change your video.
Snap
Snap to Edges — When on, clips automatically line up with other clips, markers, and the playhead so there are no accidental gaps.
Turn edge snapping on or off. When on, clips you drag jump to line up neatly with nearby clips, markers, and the playhead.
Undo
Undo — Reverses your last change. You can undo many steps in a row.
Undo the most recent change to your project. Repeating this steps further back through your edit history.
Redo
Redo — Puts back a change you just undid.
Redo the change that was most recently undone. Available until you make a new edit.
Add Media
Add Media — Brings video, photos, or music from your device into this project.
Open your device storage to choose video, photo, or audio files to add to this project. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.
Add Track
Add Track — Creates a new empty layer. Video tracks stack on top of each other; audio tracks play together.
Add a new empty video or audio track to the timeline so you can layer more clips.
Lock
Lock Track — Protects everything on this track so it cannot be moved or changed by accident.
Lock or unlock this track. While locked, clips on it cannot be moved, trimmed, or deleted.
Mute
Mute Track — Silences this track so you cannot hear it, without deleting anything.
Mute or unmute this track. Muting silences it during playback and in the exported video, but keeps the clips.
Solo
Solo Track — Plays only this track and silences all the others, so you can hear it on its own.
Solo this track. Only soloed tracks are heard; other tracks are silenced without changing their own mute settings.
Show
Show or Hide Track — Hides this track from the preview and the exported video without deleting it.
Show or hide this video track. A hidden track does not appear in the preview or in the exported video.
Export
Export Video — Turns your timeline into a finished video file saved on your device.
Open export settings to render your project into a finished video file and save it to your device gallery.
Projects
Return to Projects — Goes back to your project list. Your work is saved automatically.
Return to the project list. Any unsaved changes in this project are saved automatically before leaving.
Settings
Settings — Change performance, storage, appearance, and accessibility options.
Open app settings for performance, storage management, theme, accessibility, and licence information.
